GBP.catalyst: The British pound is navigating tight ranges near 1.3208 against the dollar, suppressed below its 20-day, 50-day, and 200-day moving averages of 1.3280, 1.3435, and 1.3440. Nonetheless, a 264-basis-point SOFR-TONA carry advantage continues to heavily incentivize long-dollar, short-yen positioning across global macro desks.
